selection: Fixed first generated sample from each of all 32 categories; no cherry-picking
finding: Broad category cues appear, especially phone, laptop, camera, flower, landscapes, pizza and cup. Many outputs are blurry or superimposed; bicycle/motorcycle/truck and faces remain weak. This is a rough statistical student, not diffusion-quality generation.
limitation: Same-author qualitative development review of generated outputs, not an independent realism benchmark
